rollback_evidence: G78: IOS XE VLAN database is read with show vlan brief separately from running-config. Only unused active Ethernet VLANs may be created, renamed or deleted. Normal-range VLANs are not reliably returned by the config archive; this table uses the existing compensating inverse and recover path, with independent check-account readback. There is no device timer for this table; loss of Admin/management requires recover. Measured on IOL-L2 17.18.2.
